title: 13. Zoom into Space!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Rumble, rumble! On the television, a huge white rocket shoots flames from its tail and rises high into the sky. Hori's eyes grow wide. Wow! That pointed rocket goes right up through the sky! Rumble! Rocket, zoom into space!
Dad, how can a rocket go so high, all the way into space? Hori asks, tapping Dad's knee. Dad smiles. Shall we visit the space center, where rockets live? Kongi can come, too!

At the space center's launchpad stands a white rocket that seems to reach the sky. Hello! Have you come to learn about rockets? A friendly astronaut in a bright white spacesuit waves. Even when Hori tips his head all the way back, the top looks very far away.

Shall we see how the rocket rises? The engines are down here. The astronaut points to the base. When the engines blast hot gas downward, that force pushes the rocket up. Hori stretches both hands downward. Zoom!

But what makes the flames? Hori asks. Big tanks inside the rocket hold fuel. The engines burn that fuel to make the powerful blast. The rocket carries what it needs for the journey into space. Kongi's eyes grow round. Wow! Rockets need a lot of food! Everyone laughs.

Where do the people sit? The astronaut points to the pointed compartment at the top. That's the spacecraft capsule where we ride. Space has no air for us to breathe, so our spacesuits and capsule keep us safe. Looking up at the high capsule, Hori swallows in wonder.

Would Hori like to be an astronaut? The padded white spacesuit is heavy, and the round helmet has a shiny visor. Kongi puts on a helmet too quickly, and those acorn-filled cheeks get stuck. I can't take it off! Everyone laughs. Hori settles into a training capsule and clicks his safety belt.

To launch, we say a countdown. Want to count, Hori? Hori takes a big breath and calls bravely, Five! Four! Three! Two! One! Lift-off! His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I launched the rocket! Rumble! Rocket, zoom into space!

Far away on the launchpad, it's time for a real launch! The engines rumble and blast orange flames. White clouds billow up. Slowly at first, then faster and faster, the rocket rises into the sky! Hori and Kongi wave both hands. Have a safe journey, rocket!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. The engines blast downward to push the rocket up. It burns lots of fuel, and the astronauts ride in the capsule on top! After the countdown, zoom into space! Hori smiles at the stars. Rumble! Rocket, zoom into space!
